reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Fix behavior when running with `--namespace=<namespace>`: limit the scope of cert-manager to a single namespace and disable cluster-scoped controllers", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: When running with --namespace=<namespace>, cert-manager now limits its scope to a single namespace and disables cluster-scoped controllers, whereas previously the flag did not behave correctly.

proposed.statement: The --namespace CLI flag behavior is fixed to properly limit cert-manager scope to a single namespace and disable cluster-scoped controllers.
